# A `PaymentSplit "…"` written at the top level, under no `Transaction` at all.
#
# The companion to `a_transaction_directive_outside_a_payment.txt`: a split is
# a child of its transaction everywhere else in this format, and one written
# with no transaction above it names a split of nothing.
#
# Refused by the parser rather than by the payment reader, because at this
# level there is no payment block to have refused it — the line would simply
# have been hung off whatever directive preceded it and never looked at again.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the line, and a book the run has
# not touched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
PaymentSplit "708192a3b4c5d6e7f809122334455667"
